scripts.build: echo 'Firmware is not part of the JS build — use pnpm fw:build (needs arduino-cli)'
scripts.fw:flash: arduino-cli compile --fqbn "$(sh scripts/fqbn.sh)" --output-dir firmware/build -u -p "$(sh scripts/port.sh)" firmware
scripts.fw:dev: arduino-cli compile --fqbn "$(sh scripts/fqbn.sh)" --output-dir firmware/build -u -p "$(sh scripts/port.sh)" firmware && arduino-cli monitor -p "$(sh scripts/port.sh)" -c baudrate=115200
